subject.title: fix(runtime): cancelled workflows no longer continue external commands

question: Should Lobster preserve workflow resume tokens until the first workflow step is dispatched, then consume the resolved token and approval index on any later cancellation to prevent replay of completed side effects?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and covered by the supplied production-path tests, but the retry-versus-consume boundary is a durable user-facing resume policy rather than a purely mechanical correction.

options.title: Confirm the proposed boundary
options.body: Keep setup-time cancellations retryable and consume the resolved resume state after first step dispatch, preventing replay after any post-start cancellation.

options.title: Require a different resume policy
options.body: Pause merge and specify a different point at which cancellation should retain or consume workflow resume capability.

recommendation.title: Confirm the proposed boundary
recommendation.body: Keep setup-time cancellations retryable and consume the resolved resume state after first step dispatch, preventing replay after any post-start cancellation.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the cancellation and resume-state implementation through the current head and can clarify the tested lifecycle boundary.
